text: {"summary":"The on‑call team is being paged repeatedly for transient conditions that resolve themselves, likely because alerts are firing on lower‑level metrics or brief spikes rather than on user‑visible latency or error rates, as warned in the alerting guidance.","likely_cause":"Mis‑configured alerts that trigger on transient traffic spikes or low‑level component latency instead of user‑visible impact","confidence":"medium","next_action":"Review and tighten alerting policies: only page on latency or errors that affect user experience, raise thresholds or add aggregation windows for high‑traffic spikes, and consider adding alert suppression or deduplication for short‑lived anomalies."}
